skill.summary: Build a validated website showcase video through capture, brand analysis, storyboarding, narration, composition, and review.

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are lexical false positives caused by Markdown links, code formatting, CSS terms, and JavaScript regular expressions. Confirmed concerns include unsafe chat-based credential handling, broad HOME searches, a predictable temporary file, and a remote script without integrity protection. The capture and Gemini workflows also need stronger URL boundaries and confidential-content safeguards.

remediation.issue: The voice setup invites users to paste reusable API keys into chat and does not require protected local storage.
remediation.suggestion: Remove all chat-based key collection. Use provider authentication, a user-managed secret store, or protected environment variables excluded from logs and version control.

remediation.issue: The capture command accepts a URL without documented destination restrictions.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only HTTP and HTTPS, resolve redirects, and block loopback, private, link-local, metadata, file, and other non-public destinations by default.

remediation.issue: External Gemini analysis can receive captured site images and video snapshots without a clear confidentiality warning.
remediation.suggestion: Request explicit upload consent, identify the provider and data sent, warn against confidential captures, and keep local visual review as the default fallback.

remediation.issue: Several instructions recursively search the user's entire HOME directory for skill files.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve skill files from installation metadata, a configured root, or the current repository. Restrict any fallback search to a known application directory.

remediation.issue: Generated previews load executable GSAP code from a CDN without integrity verification.
remediation.suggestion: Vendor the pinned dependency locally or add a verified integrity hash and restrictive Content Security Policy.

remediation.issue: The narration test writes to a predictable shared temporary filename.
remediation.suggestion: Create a private temporary directory with a unique filename, or write the test clip inside the current project.

content.user_title: Create a Branded Video From Any Website
content.value_statement: Turning a website into a coherent video requires capture, creative planning, narration, animation, and review. This skill guides the complete HyperFrames workflow using the site's own brand assets.
actual_capabilities: Captures website screenshots, visual assets, text, fonts, and design data into an isolated project directory.
Creates a brand guide from captured colors, typography, components, layout patterns, and visual references.
Develops a message, narrative arc, storyboard, and narration script with user approval gates.
Generates narration through HeyGen, ElevenLabs, or local Kokoro, then maps word timestamps to video beats.
Builds branded HTML compositions with GSAP, HyperFrames, captured media, captions, music, and sound effects.
Runs linting, snapshots, timing checks, visual review, and project validation before preview or optional rendering.
limitations: The workflow depends on HyperFrames commands and related skills that must be available in the working environment.
Gemini, HeyGen, and ElevenLabs features require separate credentials and may send project content to external providers.
Users must have permission to capture and reuse the website, brand assets, audio, and other media.
Product launches, topic explainers, pull request videos, and edits of existing videos require different workflows.

use_cases.title: Publish a Portfolio Reel
use_cases.description: Turn a portfolio or agency site into a concise branded reel using its strongest pages, typography, and visual assets.

use_cases.title: Create a Documentation Tour
use_cases.description: Present a documentation site through a structured walkthrough with readable interface details, narration, and captions.

use_cases.title: Produce a Social Showcase
use_cases.description: Adapt a homepage or content site into a short portrait, square, or landscape clip for social channels.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Site Tour
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30-second landscape tour of [URL]. Use the site's visual identity. Ask me to approve the storyboard before building.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a guided website walkthrough.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Short Social Clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn [URL] into a 15-second portrait social clip for [audience]. Emphasize [message]. Use captions and local narration.
prompt_templates.scenario: A social team needs a vertical branded video.

prompt_templates.title: Develop a Narrated Showcase
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 45-second narrated showcase of [URL]. Compare two creative directions, then build the approved direction with captured brand assets.
prompt_templates.scenario: A stakeholder wants creative choices before production.

prompt_templates.title: Direct an Advanced Brand Reel
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce a 30-second brand reel from [URL] for [audience]. Use [provider] narration, selected WebGL transitions, timed sound design, captions, and full validation.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs a complete production specification.

output_examples.input: Create a 15-second portrait clip from a design studio homepage.
output: A concise brand summary covering audience, visual voice, colors, typography, and signature assets.
An approved beat plan with a hook, proof sequence, closing message, narration, timing, and sound cues.
A validated portrait HyperFrames project with captured visuals, captions, snapshots, and a Studio preview.

output_examples.input: Turn a documentation site into a 45-second narrated walkthrough.
output_examples.output: A structured walkthrough that introduces the product, highlights key documentation areas, and closes with a clear next step.

output_examples.input: Make a silent square brand reel from a portfolio site.
output_examples.output: A music-led square composition using portfolio imagery, branded typography, timed transitions, and focused sound effects without narration.

best_practices: Confirm the message, audience, duration, format, and narrative arc before writing the storyboard.
Use captured signature visuals in meaningful beats instead of rebuilding the entire brand with generic interface elements.
Review every composition, snapshot, warning, audio cue, and verification result before sharing the final preview.
anti_patterns: Do not capture private or restricted websites without explicit authorization and a clear data-handling plan.
Do not ask users to paste API keys into chat or place credentials in files that may enter version control.
Do not skip approval and validation gates because the user requested autonomous creative decisions.

faq.question: What types of websites work with this skill?
faq.answer: It supports general websites such as portfolios, blogs, documentation, landing pages, and content sites that the capture command can access.

faq.question: Can it create portrait and square videos?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow supports landscape, portrait, and square formats with dimensions selected during the brief.

faq.question: Does narration require a paid service?
faq.answer: No. Kokoro provides local narration, while HeyGen and ElevenLabs require credentials and may have usage costs.

faq.question: Can the video include captions?
faq.answer: Yes. Word-level timestamps can drive synchronized captions after narration is generated or transcribed.

faq.question: Does the skill render an MP4 automatically?
faq.answer: No. It delivers a Studio preview first and renders an MP4 only after the user explicitly requests it.

faq.question: Is a product launch video supported?
faq.answer: No. Promotional launches and sales-focused product videos are routed to the separate product launch workflow.
